newsitem.title: USA: Work crews to converge on White House.
newsitem.headline: Work crews to converge on White House.

text.p: Work crews will converge on the White House as soon as President Clinton starts his vacation, ripping up the driveway, installing new steam pipes and doing some painting, it was announced Friday.
"There's going to be a considerable amount of renovation work throughout the entire White House complex, the residence and West Wing," White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry said.
The work will begin once the president and his family leave Aug. 17 for a three-week vacation on the Massachusetts resort island of Martha's Vineyard.
The front entrance to the West Wing, where the Oval Office is located, will be shut down as the driveway is torn up to replace old water and steam pipes.
The press briefing room will be painted and a new carpet installed, McCurry said. A new ventilation system will be put in place for the White House kitchen.
The work -- part of an overall renovation project that is slated to be completed in February -- should be finished in 60 days.
